evidence.notes: SObject.clone preserves field values and optionally removes Id.
Parent relationship values can be read by relationship name.
Child relationship list values can be read by relationship name.

source.content: @isTest private class DataSObjectCloneRelationshipsTest { @isTest static void exercisesCloneAndRelationships() { Account parent = new Account(Name = 'Parent'); Account row = new Account(Name = 'Child'); row.put('Id', '001000000000001'); row.put('Parent', parent); row.put('Contacts', new List<Contact>{new Contact(LastName = 'Smith')}); Account parentRow = row.getSObject('Parent'); System.assertEquals('Parent', parentRow.Name); List<Contact> contacts = row.getSObjects('Contacts'); System.assertEquals(1, contacts.size()); Account cloneNoId = row.clone(); System.assertEquals(null, cloneNoId.get('Id')); System.assertEquals('Child', cloneNoId.Name); Account cloneWithId = row.clone(true, true, false, false); System.assertEquals(row.get('Id'), cloneWithId.get('Id')); cloneWithId.Name = 'Clone'; System.assertEquals('Child', row.Name); } }
